responsibility: Declares the LoongArch native CPU probing interface shared by option handling and target code. It exposes helpers to cache cpucfg results, fill CPU_NATIVE configuration tables, and query the detected processor ID in numeric or string form, providing the public entry points implemented in loongarch-cpu.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public native-CPU detection entry points for the loongarch-cpu pair, such as cpucfg caching and PRID/native configuration helpers. Unlike loongarch-cpu.cc, it contains no probing logic or table-filling code, only the shared interface.
